_about: (polish1 E5, item 126) COACH STATIONS: every walled town (data/fantasy/layouts.json kinds town and town_palisade) has a coach house (tools/blender/coach_house.py, station 'coach') with its coachman standing at it (game/fantasy_places.gd). Talking to him opens the Coach page (game/panel_coach.gd): every other walled town of a country (region) already visited, with its fare in GIL (the game's chips, called gil in Aurelind: director 2026-11-23). fare = base + per_km x the straight distance in km, rounded to `round`. ride_s = how long the ride's card shows (a teleport for now; game/coach_ride.gd). coachman = his look (data outfits, appearance ids) and name; lines = what he says at the top of the page (one picked by the town). Numbers and words mine, the director's to change.
lines: Seats inside, luggage on the roof. Where to?
The horses are fed and the wheels are greased. Name the town.
Roads are long, but my coach is quicker than your boots.
Pay up front, friend. Even a coach eats.
